title: Plant-Based 'Chicken' Tagine and Couscous
subtitle: with Mango Chutney and Green Beans
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Soak couscous: Put the couscous in a large heatproof bowl, add 2 tsp olive oil and a pinch of salt. Pour over 200ml boiling water and cover with a plate. Stand for 5 mins or until the water is absorbed. Season with salt and pepper, then fluff the couscous with a fork.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, thinly slice the garlic. Trim the beans and cut into 2cm lengths. Combine the garlic, 2 tsp ginger and 1 tbs olive oil in a large bowl. Add the chicken-style strips, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Combine the mango chutney, 1 tsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tsp honey and 2 tbs boiling water in a separate bowl.
Toast almonds: Put the almonds in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, stirring, for 3-5 mins until lightly golden. Remove from the pan.

Cook tagine: Return the pan to medium-high heat. Cook the chicken-style strips, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 mins until browned. Add the almonds and chutney mixture and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 6-8 mins until the sauce is thickened and syrupy. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Cook beans and serve up: Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil. Add the beans and cook for 3 mins or until tender. Drain, then add to the couscous and toss to combine. Divide the couscous and beans and plant-based 'chicken' tagine among bowls and enjoy!
Make it yours: Stir some crumbled feta through the couscous for a salty kick, if you any on hand.
